claim: Costco's diluted EPS decreased 17% from the prior year in the 2024 fiscal year.
summary: Without tools no verified filing data for Costco's diluted EPS in FY2024 or FY2023 can be accessed, so the claimed 17% year-over-year decrease cannot be established from what is already known alone.

sub_claims.text: Costco's diluted EPS in fiscal year 2024 decreased compared to the prior year (fiscal year 2023)
sub_claims.stated_text: Costco's diluted EPS decreased from the prior year in the 2024 fiscal year
sub_claims.note: Direction of year-over-year change requires verified 10-K values for FY2024 and FY2023; no evidence available without tools.

sub_claims.text: The magnitude of the year-over-year decrease was 17%
sub_claims.note: Percentage change calculation requires both FY2024 and FY2023 diluted EPS figures; cannot be established without tools.
